page.notes: Catchword "Sophistarum" taken from the lower right, below the last line. Doubtful readings: first word "cifixum" (initial letters lost, likely "crucifixum"); "docebat"; "Animady"; "Antichristianimi reamea" (the line is damaged and the reading is uncertain). The title "Lacisium" and "Lacisi" are as printed. The "·" before "Imo" is read as a stray mark. The paragraph is read as one paragraph, with no indent before "Imo" or "Dogma".
